naslov: Paris scores 107 points and easily beats JL Bourg
tekst:
By Eurohoops team / info@eurohoops.net
Paris achieved their seventh victory in the French championship, easily defeating JL Bourg 107-77 at home in the seventh round.
Paris lost to Cholet on Tuesday, in a match from the 13th round played earlier, but Maxime Lefevre’s team continued their excellent form, securing their sixth win in the last seven games across all competitions.
Allan Dokossi had 18 points and 11 rebounds, Jared Rhoden and TJ Warren added 16 each, while Sebastian Herrera and Joao Maozinha contributed 14 each. Frank Ntilikina also scored in double figures with 12.
For the visitors, Tyrese Samuel was impressive with 15 points and 13 rebounds, while Johnny Berhanemeskel had 13 points.
